nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint) tracking the ether balance held for each hodler; written in the fallback and zeroed in party().
Constant uint partyTime = 1844690399 (15th June 2028) used as the withdrawal time gate.
Anonymous payable fallback function; credits hodlers[msg.sender] with msg.value and emits Hodl.
Withdrawal function; checks block.timestamp > partyTime and a non-zero balance, zeroes the balance, then transfers the ether to msg.sender.
Attacker-controlled caller address used as mapping key, require operand and transfer recipient.
Miner-influenced block timestamp compared against partyTime to gate withdrawal.
Unchecked arithmetic: hodlers[msg.sender] += msg.value in the payable fallback (no SafeMath, overflow possible).
External call: msg.sender.transfer(value) sends the hodled balance to an untrusted address, enabling callback re-entry.
Local uint in party() holding the cached hodlers[msg.sender] balance before it is zeroed and transferred.

edges.reason: The payable fallback adds msg.value to hodlers[msg.sender] using unchecked arithmetic.
msg.sender is the attacker-controlled index of the unchecked balance increment.
The unchecked addition directly mutates the hodlers state variable, so overflow corrupts stored balances.
block.timestamp > partyTime gates execution of party(), making withdrawal dependent on miner-controlled time.
The partyTime constant is read inside the require condition of party().
msg.sender is used as the hodlers key and require operand inside party().
hodlers[msg.sender] is read from storage into the local variable value.
msg.sender supplies the mapping key for the storage read that initializes value.
The cached local balance value is passed as the amount of the external transfer.
msg.sender is the untrusted recipient of the external ether transfer.
party() executes the external transfer to msg.sender as its final state-changing action.
If msg.sender is a contract, the transfer can re-enter the payable fallback and re-credit the balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The local variable value is only the amount consumed by the external transfer unsafe_operation, so it should be folded into that sink node.
